sections.title: Acceptance of payment through prescribed electronic modes.
sections.text_before_clauses: Every person shall provide facility for accepting payment, through electronic modes as may be prescribed, in addition to other electronic modes, if any, being provided by him, where—

clauses.text: such person is carrying on business or profession; and
total sales, turnover or gross receipts in such business or profession exceeds fifty crore rupees during the immediately preceding tax year.
